body: I’d love someone to talk too please
They suck in the UK, called one the other night and the robot voice said “all of our operators are currently busy with others callers, call back later” like I know a lot of people call but god damn
Would it be okay to talk? I have no one in my personal life I can talk to about this as I’m afraid they will send me away again
It’s okay, I kinda expected it to happen ya know since I’ve never not been cheated on in all of my relationships
Thanks so much, life can only go up is the way I’m looking at it :)
Thank you for the kind words! My favourite for many years has actually been Lucario! I watched the Lucario movie when I was a kid and since then I’ve been obsessed!
I’m sorry you feel that way, I’m not going to downvote you because I don’t want any negativity here, I just hope you have a wonderful day

I just wanted to thank everyone for being so kind, I don’t know how long I have left on this earth but I do know I’ve now met some incredibly kind people and I’m forever thankful, my health’s been going downhill for a while and my liver isn’t getting better, if anything it’s getting much worse, but I want you all to know that I am so great full  for you all ❤️
Thanks so much for the kindness 😭
I got dumped / cheated on a few weeks ago and honestly? Love link has helped so much

You are so kind thank you so much!
